تناوبت (form VI)
# تَنَاوَبْتُ (tanāwabtu) /ta.naː.wab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاوَبَ (tanāwaba)
# تَنَاوَبْتَ (tanāwabta) /ta.naː.wab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاوَبَ (tanāwaba)
# تَنَاوَبْتِ (tanāwabti) /ta.naː.wab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاوَبَ (tanāwaba)
# تَنَاوَبَتْ (tanāwabat) /ta.naː.wa.bat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
